# TilinX

> TilinX is a free desktop app that runs AI agents which do real work for you. It runs on your existing ChatGPT or Claude subscription, connects to over 1,000 tools, and works on Mac and Windows. Open source.

TilinX lets anyone hire AI agents that actually complete tasks across the apps they already use, from bookkeeping to inbox to expense reports. Bring your own model, connect your tools once, and let agents do the work.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://gettilinx.ai/): What TilinX is and how the agents work.
- [For Startups](https://gettilinx.ai/startups/): Build your AI native product fast on TilinX.
- [Guides](https://gettilinx.ai/guides/): Step by step guides for putting agents on real work.
- [Changelog](https://gettilinx.ai/changelog/): Every release in plain language.

## Other languages
- [Home (Spanish)](https://gettilinx.ai/es/): The same home page in Spanish.
- [Home (Portuguese)](https://gettilinx.ai/pt/): The same home page in Brazilian Portuguese.

## Developers
- [Developer API](https://gettilinx.ai/developers/): Start and drive agent missions programmatically over REST, A2A, and MCP. API keys, base URL, and a 60-second quickstart.
- [Missions (REST)](https://gettilinx.ai/developers/missions/): Full REST reference: create, list, get, stream (SSE), and cancel missions, API-key scope, and signed webhooks.
- [Agent2Agent (A2A)](https://gettilinx.ai/developers/a2a/): Point any A2A-capable agent at a TilinX agent over JSON-RPC (message/send, message/stream, tasks/get, tasks/cancel).
- [MCP](https://gettilinx.ai/developers/mcp/): Expose agents as tools over a stateless Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint for Claude Code and other MCP clients.
